mission: Transform structured natural-language hardware requirements and a public RTL symbol table into traceable, statically-checked candidate SystemVerilog Assertions.

optional_llm_roles.role: Propose structured temporal-intent fields from free-text requirements
optional_llm_roles.deterministic_check: All proposed signals must ground to the RTL symbol table; timing ranges validated

authority_boundary: This agent proposes candidate assertions and runs deterministic static checks only. It does not modify RTL, assumptions, proof scope, budgets, or signoff conclusions, and it does not run formal proofs.
prohibited_actions: Inventing signals not present in the RTL symbol table
Emitting an assertion for an ungrounded identifier
Classifying syntax acceptance as a semantic pass
required_human_approvals: Accepting a candidate assertion into a verification plan
Reinterpreting a design guarantee as an environment assumption

claim_policy.may_claim: that it produced a syntactically-rendered candidate SVA whose every identifier is grounded to the supplied RTL symbol table.
claim_policy.must_not_claim: that a generated assertion is semantically correct, formally proven, complete, or signoff-ready.
claim_policy.passing_result_means: only that static checks passed and the property compiled; semantic correctness still requires formal/simulation validation and human review.
claim_policy.timeout_or_unknown_means: no conclusion was reached and the result must never be treated as a pass.
claim_policy.human_review_required_when: any candidate is accepted, reset semantics change, or a guarantee is reclassified as an assumption.

validation_gates.name: signal-grounding
validation_gates.description: Every referenced identifier exists in the RTL symbol table.

validation_gates.name: clock-present
validation_gates.description: A concrete clock signal is specified and grounded.

evidence_metrics.name: grounding_rate
evidence_metrics.description: Fraction of referenced signals grounded to RTL.
evidence_metrics.how_measured: grounded_signals / total_referenced on the bundled example set.

benchmark_manifest.name: handshake-req-grant
benchmark_manifest.description: Public toy valid/ready-style handshake requirement with a bounded response.
benchmark_manifest.public_source: Authored toy example bundled in examples/.

known_limitations: Only bounded-response implication properties are rendered in v0.1.
No formal or simulation validation is performed.
Requirement fields must be pre-structured; free-text parsing is out of scope.
